Package dev.relism.flash.ext.webdav.nio

Class StandaloneNioDavHandler

java.lang.Object
dev.relism.flash.http.Handler
dev.relism.flash.http.RequestHandler
dev.relism.flash.ext.webdav.DavHandler
dev.relism.flash.ext.webdav.nio.NioDavHandler
dev.relism.flash.ext.webdav.nio.StandaloneNioDavHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
Bound
public abstract non-sealed class StandaloneNioDavHandler extends NioDavHandler
A directory one process serves: the bytes in use, uploads in progress and locks live in its memory. Every name under the root, .dav included, is the client's. 

 @Dav("/drive/**") @Authenticated
 final class Drive extends StandaloneNioDavHandler {
     @Override protected Path root(Request req) { return disk.resolve(me().id()); }
     @Override protected long quota(Request req) { return quotas.forRole(me().role()); }
 }

When several processes serve the same directory, use ClusteredNioDavHandler: with this one each process would count the quota and keep the locks alone.
